title: The Clinical Course of Coronary Artery Disease in Coronary Multidetector Computed Tomographic Angiogram
brief_summary: Study Type: Observational Study Design: Observational Model: Defined Population Observational Model: Natural History Time Perspective: Longitudinal Time Perspective: Prospective
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Patients with known or suspected coronary artery disease

Exclusion Criteria:

* Irregular heart beat
* Known allergy towards the contrast agent
* Renal dysfunction
* Impossible breath-hold
* Acute coronary syndrome patient
